subject: Renewal kickoff — term shift, capacity uplift roadmap & QBR availability
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@cloudfin.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — term shift, capacity uplift roadmap & QBR availability

Hi Sam / Aisha —

Thanks again for the candid conversation last week. As we discussed, CloudFin is coming up on term renewal in Q4 and you indicated interest in a ramped capacity plan plus a short-term term adjustment to align procurement timing. I wanted to start a concise kickoff thread to:

- Align stakeholders (Sales / CS / Exec sponsor)
- Share a proposed mutual action plan (attached) and initial timeline
- Book a 60-minute QBR in July to walk the roadmap and cost/throughput tradeoffs

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed QBR agenda. High-level timeline we’re proposing:
1) This week (Jun 14–18): agree stakeholders, confirm uplift targets and term preference
2) Jun 21–25: finalize MAP, pricing uplift options, and legal redline window
3) Jul 5–9: joint QBR (60m) to review workload projections and rollout plan
4) Jul 12–Aug 2: procurement & DocuSign for term amendment / capacity add

Action items for this thread:
- Sam/Aisha: confirm exec sponsor + procurement contact (we’ve provisionally added Lisa Nguyen)
- Ben: I’ve looped Ben to provide a capacity forecast and cost delta table
- Marissa: CS lead for onboarding timeline and pilot resources

Please reply with any changes to the timeline or stakeholders. I’ll send a Doodle poll for QBR slots (link below) once we have confirmed participants.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: CloudFin_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, QBR_Agenda_DRAFT.docx

---

From: Sam Torres <s.torres@cloudfin.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloudfin.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudfin.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, capacity uplift roadmap & QBR availability

Thanks Rachel — this is great and appreciated. Confirming:
- Exec sponsor: Marcus Reed (CC’d via separate calendar invite)
- Procurement: Lisa Nguyen (added here)

We’re aiming for a capacity uplift of ~2.5x for peak inference over the next 12 months. On the term side, legal prefers a 9-month bridge amendment (instead of immediate annual) to sync fiscal cycles — happy to discuss.

I’ll take a look at the MAP and propose a couple of QBR times in the Doodle. If Ben can surface the incremental cost and any options for staged burst capacity, that’ll help our CFO sign off.

Sam
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudFin

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, Sam Torres <s.torres@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, capacity uplift roadmap & QBR availability

+1 on the MAP — I ran a quick model for the uplift Sam mentioned. Attached in the MAP sheet is a staged rollout option: 1) immediate 1.5x reserve, 2) add burst pool for seasonal peaks, 3) switch to steady 2.5x at renewal.

Quick notes:
- Estimated monthly delta (steady-state): ~$28k (quantized profile), with peak burst credits billed separately
- If CloudFin can commit to a 9-month bridge, we can offer a phased discount structure (see MAP tab: Pricing Scenarios)

I’ll be on the QBR to talk about runtime tuning options that could cut the unit cost by ~12% without degrading p95 latency.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@cloudfin.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cloudfin.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, capacity uplift roadmap & QBR availability

Perfect — thanks all. I’ve updated the MAP with Ben’s staged pricing scenarios and added Lisa to the map. Marissa will follow up with a short pilot checklist post-QBR.

Next steps (concrete):
- I’ll send the Doodle poll to lock a July QBR (target week Jul 5–9) — link: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-qbr-poll
- Marissa: CS to prepare a 30-minute pilot plan to run during the uplift ramp (deliverable by Jun 29)
- Rachel: will prepare a one-page exec summary for Marcus and the CFO by Jun 21

When we agree on the slot I’ll route the amendment to DocuSign and loop Legal. Thanks everyone — looking forward to the QBR.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced as stubs above.
